trackedEnvironmentBaseline.version: required for classifying SEC; immutable/versioned identifier

candidateIdentity.candidateAffectedComponent: component ID or explicit TECHNOLOGY_WIDE scope, backed by evidence; unresolved if absent
candidateIdentity.aliasMapping: exact versioned map only; no fuzzy matching

directExposure.false: Predicate evaluated with evidence and complete dataset coverage; a missing search result alone is not false.
directExposure.unknown: Reason, conflicts/staleness or missing authority recorded; blocks lower-specificity classification.
directExposure.notApplicable: Versioned applicability rule plus evidence required; distinct from false.
directExposure.missing: No valid evaluation record; never defaults to false or N/A.

dependencyRelationship.false: Predicate evaluated with evidence and complete dataset coverage; a missing search result alone is not false.
dependencyRelationship.unknown: Reason, conflicts/staleness or missing authority recorded; blocks lower-specificity classification.
dependencyRelationship.notApplicable: Versioned applicability rule plus evidence required; distinct from false.
dependencyRelationship.missing: No valid evaluation record; never defaults to false or N/A.

ecosystemRelationship.false: Predicate evaluated with evidence and complete dataset coverage; a missing search result alone is not false.
ecosystemRelationship.unknown: Reason, conflicts/staleness or missing authority recorded; blocks lower-specificity classification.
ecosystemRelationship.notApplicable: Versioned applicability rule plus evidence required; distinct from false.
ecosystemRelationship.missing: No valid evaluation record; never defaults to false or N/A.

authorityRules.sourceAuthority: must resolve in the exact versioned authority map included by the tracked-environment baseline
authorityRules.modelJudgment: may assist discovery only; cannot by itself assert TRUE/FALSE/NOT_APPLICABLE for direct exposure or dependency; absent deterministic evidence => UNKNOWN
authorityRules.falseEvidence: must include query/evaluation record and complete coverage attestation
authorityRules.naEvidence: must include rule ID/version and applicability basis
authorityRules.conflict: conflicting facts that cannot be reconciled as identity inputs => INVALID_INPUT; conflicting factual assessments => UNKNOWN/UNRESOLVED

trackedEnvironmentBaselineVersioning.reason: Candidate class can change as tracked inventory/scope changes; capture exact baseline version/hash for reproducibility.

scoreEligibility.unresolvedClassification: RECEIPT_ONLY; no valid securityGate enum or approved partial scoring path exists
scoreEligibility.resolvedClass: may proceed to other existing SCORE_READY checks
scoreEligibility.authority: Frozen Score Input Generation Policy 2.1.0 requires every required field READY; no defaults/partial scoring.
